description: Compare two JSON documents and get every change with its pointer, classified as added, removed, retyped or revalued. Object key order is not a change. Array order is, unless you say the arrays are unordered. Numbers compare exactly, so 42.50 and 42.5 are the same value and two adjacent large integers are not. Pay 60000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: Any JSON value you supply. Nothing is fetched, so this works on payloads nothing could reach.

before.description: Any JSON value you supply. Nothing is fetched, so this works on payloads nothing could reach.

ignore_pointers.description: Pointers to exclude, such as a generated timestamp. Exclusions are counted and listed rather than silently dropped.

unordered_arrays.description: Compare arrays as multisets rather than positionally, so a reordering is not a change. Defaults to false, because order is meaningful in a tuple.

name: json_snapshot_diff

same_numeric_value.description: Set when a type changed but the number survived, which is materially different from a value change.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of the input was not analysed, which is a different problem from input that is wrong.

identical.description: True only when the whole comparison completed and nothing differed. Equal as far as it looked is not identical.

not_examined.description: Named reasons anything was left unexamined: a bound reached, an unsupported keyword, an unresolvable reference, or findings beyond the listing cap.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: JSON Snapshot Diff
